secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key — powers the David chat, mood scriptures, verse of the day, reflections, and Whisper transcription. Obtain from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
secrets.description: ElevenLabs API key — powers David's spoken voice (text-to-speech). Obtain from https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys.

secrets.name: ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID
secrets.description: ElevenLabs voice ID for David's voice. A default is already set; override only if you have a custom voice. Obtain from the ElevenLabs voice library.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL — powers user auth and profiles in the frontend. Without it the app runs in guest mode. Obtain from https://supabase.com/dashboard > Project Settings > API.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon (public) key — paired with VITE_SUPABASE_URL for frontend auth. Obtain from https://supabase.com/dashboard > Project Settings > API.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key — server-side admin access for webhook handlers and reflection limits. Obtain from https://supabase.com/dashboard > Project Settings > API.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key — powers checkout sessions and subscription management. Obtain from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret — verifies local webhook events. Obtain from https://dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks.

secrets.name: VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key — frontend Stripe.js integration. Obtain from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys.

secrets.name: VITE_STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PRO
secrets.description: Stripe price ID for the Pro subscription plan. Obtain from https://dashboard.stripe.com/products.
